name: zetteltex
description: Language support for ZettelTeX: contextual completion of notes and labels inside \excref/\exref/\exhyperref.

commands.title: ZettelTeX: Render current note or project

zetteltex.lsp.path.markdownDescription: Path to the `zetteltex` executable (name on PATH, or absolute path) used by the language server.

zetteltex.cli.path.markdownDescription: Path to the `zetteltex` executable (name on PATH, or absolute path) used to run commands such as `render`.

zetteltex.tex.binDir.markdownDescription: Absolute path to the TeX Live binaries directory (the one containing `pdflatex`). Prepended to `PATH` when running `zetteltex` tasks. Leave empty to auto-detect under `/usr/local/texlive` and `/opt/texlive`.

zetteltex.cli.env.markdownDescription: Extra environment variables (string -> string) applied to every `zetteltex` task.

scripts.package: npm run compile && npm run esbuild
